name: Huss Valley Chase (blocky-avatar panic sprint)
visual_dna: Generic blocky low-poly game avatar (original design, no platform branding) sprinting at absurd speed
First-person or tight follow-cam, heavy camera shake, motion blur, speed lines
Chaotic cartoon valley with bouncing terrain and obstacle props
A giant glowing red error monster (e.g. 'LEAK', '#N/A', 'DRIP') looming and gaining from behind
Freeze-frame on the escape move: bright on-screen fix card, then the chase resumes and the monster pops
character_sheet_prompt: Single full-frame vertical 9:16 cinematic action shot (not a reference sheet, no labels, no turnaround, no text anywhere) of an original blocky low-poly game avatar with a square head, simple painted face showing panic, bright orange hoodie and blue shorts, mid-sprint pose, plus a giant glowing red blob monster with dripping water and angry glowing eyes, chasing from behind across a bright cartoon valley, low camera angle, motion blur, toy-like 3D render, no words, no letters, no logos, no real game branding
audio_vibe: Fast panting chant 'huss huss huss' (performed by our own voice), 150 bpm chiptune-style chase loop (original), alarm stingers when the monster gains, a satisfying pop when the fix lands
hook_formula: 0-1 s: mid-sprint, monster already huge in the background, avatar yells the problem name. Caption: 'HUSS HUSS HUSS' + the error name in red.
reusable_broll_prompts: 9:16 fast follow-cam of an original blocky low-poly cartoon avatar in an orange hoodie sprinting down a bouncy cartoon valley, camera shake, speed lines, loopable 4 seconds, no logos
9:16 wide shot: giant glowing red blob monster chasing a tiny blocky cartoon avatar across a cartoon valley, dramatic, toy-like 3D
9:16 slow-motion freeze: blocky cartoon avatar jumping over a gap while a red monster bursts into confetti behind them
retention_psychology: High arousal (being chased) plus a rhythmic chant creates an audio earworm; the 'escape move' is the only calm moment, so the fix becomes the relief memory; ideal as the CALLBACK format for a concept first learned in a calm format.
teaching_fit: callback / spaced recall in a new context
safety_notes: Do not use Roblox or any platform's name, logo, UI or avatar likeness in generated media; describe a generic blocky avatar
Panting chant is performed by our own voice, never sampled
Keep the threat cartoonish; no realistic violence
